
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```


## add data

```{r}
VFT <- read_csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/processed data/VFT_long_upto2025.csv")
Climvar <- read_csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/processed data/Climvar_upto2025.csv")
```
## add annual variables

#### local
```{r}
TP_LA<- Climvar %>%
  group_by(startyear, site) %>%    # for startyear of 2021 for example, months 6-12 were in 2021 and 1-5 were in 2022.
  summarise(T_LA = mean(local_T,na.rm = TRUE),P_LA = mean(local_P,na.rm = TRUE))


VFT$T_LA <- NA
VFT$P_LA <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(VFT)) {
  site_i = VFT$site[i]
  startyear_i = VFT$startyear[i]
  
  VFT$T_LA [i] <- TP_LA$T_LA[which(TP_LA$site == site_i & TP_LA$startyear== startyear_i) ]
  VFT$P_LA [i] <- TP_LA$P_LA[which(TP_LA$site == site_i & TP_LA$startyear== startyear_i) ]
}

head(VFT)
```

#### regional
```{r}
TP_RA<- Climvar %>%
  group_by(startyear, site) %>%    # for startyear of 2021 for example, months 6-12 were in 2021 and 1-5 were in 2022.
  summarise(T_RA = mean(regional_T,na.rm = TRUE),P_RA = sum(regional_P))


VFT$T_RA <- NA
VFT$P_RA <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(VFT)) {
  site_i = VFT$site[i]
  startyear_i = VFT$startyear[i]
  
  VFT$T_RA [i] <- TP_RA$T_RA[which(TP_RA$site == site_i & TP_RA$startyear== startyear_i) ]
  VFT$P_RA [i] <- TP_RA$P_RA[which(TP_RA$site == site_i & TP_RA$startyear== startyear_i) ]
}

head(VFT)
```

##add extreme month variables

####local
```{r}
Hottest_month <- 7
Coldest_month <- 1
driest_month <- 12
wettest_month <- 8       ### these values are obtained from Louthan et al., 2022 (https://esajournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/ecm.1528). These were calculated from historical avergaes of precipitation and temperature data.

TP_LM<- Climvar %>%
  group_by(startyear, site, newMonth) %>%    
  summarise(T_LM = mean(local_T,na.rm = TRUE),P_LM = mean(local_P,na.rm = TRUE), 
            T_LMax= max(local_T,na.rm = TRUE), T_LMin= min(local_T,na.rm = TRUE))

VFT$T_LH <- VFT$T_LC <- VFT$T_LW <- VFT$T_LD <- VFT$P_LH <- VFT$P_LW <- VFT$P_LD <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(VFT)) {
  site_i = VFT$site[i]
  startyear_i = VFT$startyear[i]

  # VFT$T_LH [i] <- ifelse(which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_LM$newMonth==Hottest_month)=0, NA,TP_LM$T_LMax[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_LM$newMonth==Hottest_month)])
  # VFT$T_LC [i] <- ifelse(length(which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_LM$newMonth==Coldest_month))== 0, NA, TP_LM$T_LMin[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_LM$newMonth==Coldest_month)])
  VFT$T_LH [i] <- TP_LM$T_LMax[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_LM$newMonth==Hottest_month)]
  VFT$T_LC [i] <- TP_LM$T_LMin[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_LM$newMonth==Coldest_month)]
  VFT$T_LW [i] <- TP_LM$T_LM[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_LM$newMonth==wettest_month) ]
  VFT$T_LD [i] <- TP_LM$T_LM[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_LM$newMonth==driest_month) ]
  VFT$P_LH [i] <- TP_LM$P_LM[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_LM$newMonth==Hottest_month) ]
  VFT$P_LW [i] <- TP_LM$P_LM[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_LM$newMonth==wettest_month) ]
  VFT$P_LD [i] <- TP_LM$P_LM[which(TP_LM$site == site_i & TP_LM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_LM$newMonth==driest_month) ]

}

```

#### regional 

```{r}
TP_RM<- Climvar %>%
  group_by(startyear, site, newMonth) %>%    
  summarise(T_RM = mean(local_T,na.rm = TRUE),P_RM = sum(local_P,na.rm = TRUE), 
            T_RMax= max(local_T,na.rm = TRUE), T_RMin= min(local_T,na.rm = TRUE))

VFT$T_RH <- VFT$T_RC <- VFT$T_RW <- VFT$T_RD <- VFT$P_RH <- VFT$P_RW <- VFT$P_RD <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(VFT)) {
  site_i = VFT$site[i]
  startyear_i = VFT$startyear[i]

  # VFT$T_RH [i] <- ifelse(which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_RM$newMonth==Hottest_month)=0, NA,TP_RM$T_RMax[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_RM$newMonth==Hottest_month)])
  # VFT$T_RC [i] <- ifelse(length(which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_RM$newMonth==Coldest_month))== 0, NA, TP_RM$T_RMin[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_RM$newMonth==Coldest_month)])
  VFT$T_RH [i] <- TP_RM$T_RMax[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_RM$newMonth==Hottest_month)]
  VFT$T_RC [i] <- TP_RM$T_RMin[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i & TP_RM$newMonth==Coldest_month)]
  VFT$T_RW [i] <- TP_RM$T_RM[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_RM$newMonth==wettest_month) ]
  VFT$T_RD [i] <- TP_RM$T_RM[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_RM$newMonth==driest_month) ]
  VFT$P_RH [i] <- TP_RM$P_RM[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_RM$newMonth==Hottest_month) ]
  VFT$P_RW [i] <- TP_RM$P_RM[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_RM$newMonth==wettest_month) ]
  VFT$P_RD [i] <- TP_RM$P_RM[which(TP_RM$site == site_i & TP_RM$startyear== startyear_i& TP_RM$newMonth==driest_month) ]

}

```
